summary: Connect product portfolios, OKRs, delivery risk and benefits realization. Explore the course and plan your next delivery governance step.
lede: Product-oriented portfolio management helps experienced project managers, PMO leaders and product owners connect investment choices with measurable service outcomes. Participants practise prioritizing work with value-and-risk criteria, linking product goals to OKRs, and designing proportionate governance and benefits-tracking artefacts for digital delivery. The work includes portfolio review and decision tools they can adapt to their operating context.
audienceIntro: This course suits experienced professionals responsible for portfolio investment choices, product outcomes, delivery governance or benefits evidence in organizations modernizing how they fund and oversee digital work.
prerequisites: Prior experience managing projects, portfolios, PMO controls or product delivery is expected. Familiarity with agile delivery and basic portfolio reporting will help you contribute to the applied exercises. No coding is required; spreadsheet exercises can use Excel or an equivalent spreadsheet already available to you.
